## Body

F274 at12e0017 adds unheard_since_boot: one atomic/deadline check per lapse decision, plus a lease-map contains only inside the boot window. The conditional sleep is ONE-SHOT, until native_started_at + configured lease(default60s). Serial follower has one active wait, not N*60s; no lock spans it. A heartbeat does not wake it early. Deadline bound is not a total restart/follower latency bound; backlog/scheduler/store/record/control work remains.

Late native_receiver_renewed runs only for a would-be ExtensionLost Restart. Count up to TWO early/late guards, each global native lock + registry.get(schema PRAGMA/keyed SELECT) + lease-map read, plus the independent initial registry read. The late read holds the auth slot; native lock is dropped before record/control. No extra per-tick F274 work. F268 owed/prune corrections accepted; recommended20s heartbeat is not a rate cap. Source: auth_recovery.rs:266-342,720-770; delivery/mod.rs:790-830.

Shutdown aborts/awaits the follower(lib.rs:405-406), so an ordinary boot sleep need not await its deadline; no full shutdown witness run. R1 cost PASS-WITH-NOTES, independent correctness/security not cleared. Exact-head CI44929325713/job136922278656/artifact14717360742:2839 cases, zero failed/error/skipped; eleven selected cases pass.
